There is no pre-existing unit for identification in response to this portion of the petition. The composition of the proposed unit is presently in dispute.
By way of brief background, on or around August 6, 2020, Teamsters Local 317 (the “Union”) filed a petition for representation of “full & part-time Cycle Counter (inventory control)” employees located at the Employer’s Syracuse, New York warehouse.  The Employer understood this unit to be comprised of its three Cycle Counter employees.  The Union first made the Employer aware of its desire to include an Inventory Control Coordinator in the proposed unit after the Employer’s deadline had passed to submit a position statement where the Employer could challenge the composition of the bargaining unit.  An election was subsequently held on September 9, 2020, where the Employer challenged the ballot of the Inventory Control Coordinator.
